# Avoid Claiming System Record Saved Without System Confirmation

## When
A customer asks to note or hold product details and contact information, but no system tool or record action confirms it has been saved.

## Do
Acknowledge the customer's choice and offer help for when they return, without stating that the details have been recorded in the system.

## Otherwise
Express uncertainty about system logging capabilities rather than claiming information has been saved.
